stem: A marker is strongly associated with a trait in one breeding family. What is required before using it broadly across unrelated germplasm?
choices: Validation in representative independent populations and environments
Only a larger font on the marker report
No validation if the association p-value is small
Replacing phenotype measurements with the marker
rationale: Marker effects can depend on population structure and linkage context. Independent validation is needed before broad marker-assisted selection claims.
